title: Mosunetuzumab: A bispecific CD20 × CD3 antibody for follicular lymphoma with promising evidence in other B-NHL subtypes.
snippet: Mosunetuzumab is a bispecific antibody targeting CD20 x CD3 re-directing T cells to target and destroy CD20-positive B cells. T-cell-based therapies including bispecific antibodies have revolutionized B-cell NHL treatment. Mosunetuzumab is approved for follicular lymphoma with at least 2 prior lines of therapy.
